detail.longDescription: I built Daysift because I kept ending up with 100+ tabs open just to avoid losing things I had seen or browsed before. Bookmarks never really worked for me because often you don't remember where something was, or what it was called. However, often I remembered what it was about. It's a Chrome extension that gives you a private way to find anything you visited before. It currently filters out noise, or things that don't associate with productivity or loosely with work. It's local first and designed around not retaining any data remotely. The AI layer is powered by Proton Lumo. It can also run AI on some things or pages, e.g. summarising them and a few other things. All of that is by user-consent only. It has a note taker feature and also a way to start new files from it ('/Doc' function). I'd love any feedback.
